description: Utilities for syntax highlighting and search term highlighting in Sphinx HTML documentation, including functions for highlighting text, managing search highlights, and initializing event listeners.

methods.name: _highlight
methods.description: Recursively highlights occurrences of a search term within a DOM node, wrapping matches in span or SVG tspan elements.

methods.name: _highlightText
methods.description: Highlights multiple search terms within a DOM node by calling _highlight.

methods.name: highlightSearchWords
methods.description: Highlights search terms stored in local storage or URL parameters within the document.

methods.name: hideSearchWords
methods.description: Removes all search term highlights from the document.

methods.name: initEscapeListener
methods.description: Sets up a keyboard event listener to hide search highlights when Escape is pressed, if enabled.
